_meta.name: AlmiOET corridor proof batch — v1 (nursing → UK, 4 origins)
_meta.purpose: Test whether the ORIGIN dimension is real for OET journeys — built Nasir's way (search the origin side + its real facts), then MEASURE against the gate rather than assume. If these 4 clear the gate distinct, the corridor axis is real and we scale it; if they collapse, we learn it honestly.
_meta.method: Searched how each origin's nurses actually search + their real origin-specific facts (origin regulator, verification/good-standing process, English-exemption status, local wording). Destination facts (NMC OET grades) from enrichment_v3. Uniform steps (CBT/OSCE/visa) are SHARED and must be de-emphasised so the origin-distinct content dominates.
_meta.gateExpectation: Each corridor's distinct content = origin regulator + verification process + exemption status + local wording. Uniform NMC steps are linked to the destination page, NOT repeated per corridor. CC to compose so origin content dominates, then measure sibling-overlap.
_meta.verifyPolicy: Exemption status + verification specifics carry verifyStatus; every page shows 'confirm with the NMC and your national council' + lastVerified. No fabrication.

destination.oetRequirement: L B · R B · W C+ · S B (from enrichment_v3; base owns grades)
destination.uniformSteps_sharedNotRepeated: NMC application → CBT (computer-based test) → English evidence → OSCE (on arrival) → PIN. These are identical for all origins and live on the destination/registration page, linked, not copied into each corridor.
destination.visa: UK Health and Care Worker visa (route broadly common across origins).

englishExemption.basis: Pakistan is not on the NMC's list for the training-taught-in-English route; a Pakistani-trained nurse must evidence English via OET (L/R/S B, W C+) or IELTS.

corridors.originVerification: The NMC requires a verification of registration (good standing) sent directly from the PNMC. Pakistani nurses obtain PNMC foreign verification / good-standing through the PNMC's verification-registration process before or during the NMC application.
corridors.originDistinctContent: PNMC good-standing route + timelines + Pakistan not qualifying for the English exemption (OET/IELTS required) + Pakistani document/attestation specifics.

corridors.originRegulator: Nursing and Midwifery Council of Nigeria (NMCN)
searchWording: nurse UK from Nigeria English exemption

englishExemption.basis: Nigerian pre-registration nursing is taught and examined in English, so a Nigerian-trained nurse MAY meet the NMC English requirement via the 'taught in English' route rather than sitting OET/IELTS — a genuinely different answer from Pakistan/India.

corridors.originVerification: The NMC requires certificate verification sent directly from the NMCN. Nigerian nurses use the NMCN's Verification of Certificates process.
corridors.originDistinctContent: NMCN verification-of-certificates route + the English-exemption via English-medium training (the headline distinct fact) + Nigerian attestation specifics. This is the corridor most different from the others because of the exemption.

corridors.originRegulator: Indian Nursing Council (INC) + State Nursing Councils
searchWording: state nursing council good standing UK

englishExemption.basis: Indian-trained nurses generally evidence English via OET (L/R/S B, W C+) or IELTS; confirm current NMC position on training-in-English route.

corridors.originVerification: Verification of registration comes from the relevant State Nursing Council (and/or INC). India's federal structure means the verifying body is the STATE council of registration — an origin-distinct wrinkle (e.g. which state council, its process).
corridors.originDistinctContent: State-council verification (not one national body — the India-specific complexity) + OET/IELTS requirement + Indian degree/attestation specifics.

corridors.originRegulator: Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) — Board of Nursing

englishExemption.basis: Philippine nursing is taught and examined in English, so a Filipino-trained nurse MAY meet the NMC English requirement via the 'taught in English' route — like Nigeria, unlike Pakistan/India.

corridors.originVerification: Verification of registration from the PRC Board of Nursing, sent to the NMC. Filipino nurses use the PRC's verification/authentication process.
corridors.originDistinctContent: PRC verification route + the English-exemption via English-medium training + Philippine (red-ribbon/apostille) authentication specifics.
